result.title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
result.summary: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. Pairing is required only for the anchors: the unpaired collections may be drawn independently from the two marginals, so that no item outside the anchor set needs to have both of its modalities observed. We evaluate on image-text and molecule-text alignment, where our method outperforms existing approaches at the same anchor budget on Flickr30k, MS-COCO and ChEBI-20.

AI.brief_summary: 研究在仅有约100–500对配对样本、两侧无配对数据充足的条件下对齐两个独立预训练单模态编码器：以对N个锚点的相似度建立公共坐标，用带边缘约束的熵最优传输匹配两模态点云以抑制 hubness，并将传输方案蒸馏进轻量编码器，在 Flickr30k、MS-COCO 与 ChEBI-20 上评测图文及分子-文本对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「边缘约束的熵最优传输 + 蒸馏成归纳式编码器」思路，可能为 LVR 中潜在推理状态与视觉 token 的跨模态对应、以及 latent 相似度里 hubness 与位置偏差的度量提供可供核查的方法线索；但原文不涉及推理或 latent 状态生成，迁移需自行验证。
